name: ShunSin Technology Holdings Limited
blurb: ShunSin Technology (TWSE: 6451) is a Foxconn (Far East) subsidiary that packages and tests system-in-package (SiP) modules — including fiber-optic transceiver modules and thick-film hybrid integrated circuits — for cloud server, consumer electronics, and hearing-aid customers. Its optical transceiver business places it in the AI data-center supply chain, and it is actively accelerating silicon-photonics and co-packaged-optics deployment under pressure from hyperscaler customers seeking qualified module suppliers.
recent: Shares climbed roughly 263% over the prior 12 months to approximately TWD 405 as of late April 2026, within a 52-week range of TWD 120–530. Digitimes reported in late 2025 that ShunSin was building a full-stack optical transceiver module capability and piloting AI data-center CPO integration with cloud service providers. The stock is thinly covered by English-language sell-side research.

sources.title: ShunSin builds full-stack optical transceiver modules (Digitimes, Nov 2025)
